name: Remove startup apps delay
description: Windows waits several seconds after sign in before launching startup apps. This starts them immediately.

name: Faster menus
description: Removes the 400 millisecond pause before cascading menus open.

name: Disable SysMain prefetching
description: Stops the service that preloads apps into memory. It brings little on a solid state drive and causes background disk activity.

name: Stop apps running in the background
description: Prevents Store apps from running when closed. Some apps will stop delivering notifications.

name: Disable Fast Startup
description: Makes shutdown a full shutdown instead of a hibernation snapshot. Fixes stale driver state at the cost of a slightly slower cold boot.

name: Disable transparency effects
description: Turns off the blur behind the taskbar, Start and system windows, which saves a little GPU time.

name: Disable window animations
description: Removes minimize and maximize animations so windows respond instantly. Applies after the next sign in.
